Steps: 1. Open the Home screen. 2. Locate the Speak Back card. 3. Select Start.
Expected Result: The Choose a Friend screen opens and the user can proceed into the Speak Back flow.

Steps: 1. Open the Home screen. 2. Select the X on the Speak Back card.
Expected Result: The card is dismissed for the day and the learner remains on Home.

Steps: 1. Open Choose a Friend. 2. Review the listed friends. 3. Check a mutual friend and a friend learning a different language.
Expected Result: Mutual friends learning the relevant language are selectable; ineligible friends are visibly disabled with a clear explanation.

Steps: 1. On Choose a Friend, select an eligible mutual friend.
Expected Result: The selected friend is carried into the next screen and the Prompt and Hints screen opens.

Steps: 1. Select a friend. 2. Review the speaking prompt and its English translation.
Expected Result: A prompt appropriate to the learner's course level is displayed with its meaning in English.

Steps: 1. Open the Prompt and Hints screen. 2. Review the three helpful-word/phrase chips. 3. Expand See an example answer.
Expected Result: Three helpful phrases are visible and the example answer can be expanded and collapsed without leaving the prompt screen.

Steps: 1. On the Prompt and Hints screen, select Shuffle prompt. 2. Compare the prompt before and after.
Expected Result: A different prompt is displayed at the same course level; the learner remains on the prompt screen.

Steps: 1. On the Prompt and Hints screen, select I'm ready.
Expected Result: The Record and Review screen opens and retains the selected friend and prompt context.

Steps: 1. On Record and Review, press and hold the microphone control. 2. Observe the timer and waveform. 3. Continue up to the 60-second limit and release.
Expected Result: The recording state is apparent, the timer/waveform respond, and recording does not exceed 60 seconds. Note: prototype recording is simulated; this does not verify real microphone capture.

Feature / Scenario: Play back a recording before sending
Steps: 1. Complete a simulated recording. 2. Select Play.
Expected Result: The recorded audio preview plays and playback controls/state are understandable to the learner.

Steps: 1. Complete a recording. 2. Select Re-record. 3. Record again.
Expected Result: The previous take is cleared and the learner can create a replacement recording before sending.

Feature / Scenario: Prevent sending a recording under five seconds
Steps: 1. Record a voice message shorter than five seconds. 2. Attempt to send it.
Expected Result: A Try saying a little more message is shown and Send remains disabled until the recording is at least five seconds long.

Steps: 1. Record a message of at least five seconds. 2. Select Send to the chosen friend. 3. Observe the confirmation and next screen.
Expected Result: A sent confirmation appears, the user is taken to the conversation thread, and the friend-notification state is communicated.

Feature / Scenario: Conversation playback, reply and exchange state
Steps: 1. Open a conversation containing voice messages. 2. Play a message at 1× and 0.75×. 3. Select a preset reaction. 4. Select Reply with voice. 5. Review the Friend Streak banner when both participants have sent a message.
Expected Result: Messages play at both speeds; preset reactions can be sent; Reply with voice returns to recording with the same prompt; the spoke today badge appears only after both sides send. The exchange does not replace the daily lesson.

Feature / Scenario: Access and use conversation safety controls
Steps: 1. From the conversation, open the ⋯ menu. 2. Open Report this message and review the reason/submit flow. 3. Review Block, Mute and Turn off Speak Back controls and their confirmation/copy.
Expected Result: Safety controls are discoverable from the conversation; report provides a reason and confirmation; block has a clear confirmation/cancel choice; mute and feature-off controls are clearly labelled. Verify actual enforcement separately in a functional build.
